svg.title: How I like to build. Small tools that do one thing and have a README. Standard library first, as few dependencies as possible. Treat every input as hostile: validate it, bound it, and test it with bad data. Verify what gets downloaded, and refuse to guess when something looks wrong. I'm a goodboy no no crime post here. Me pro gammer MLBB, PUBGM, PG3D, BloodStrike, Roblox 😈😈😱😱
